title.en: Anthropic Launches Claude Sonnet 5 as New Default Model
title.zhHans: Anthropic 发布 Claude Sonnet 5：最强中端模型成为默认选择

searchSummary.en: Anthropic launched Claude Sonnet 5 on June 30, 2026 — the most agentic Sonnet ever, offering near-Opus performance at lower cost. Became the default model for all Claude users.
searchSummary.zhHans: Anthropic 于2026年6月30日发布 Claude Sonnet 5——史上最强的 Sonnet 系列，以更低价格提供接近 Opus 的性能，并成为所有 Claude 用户的默认模型。

summary.en: On June 30, 2026, Anthropic launched Claude Sonnet 5, positioning it as the default model for all Free and Pro Claude users worldwide starting July 1. The model delivers near-Opus agentic performance at significantly lower cost, with introductory pricing of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens through August 31. Anthropic described Sonnet 5 as its 'most agentic Sonnet model to date,' capable of making plans, using tools like browsers and terminals, and operating autonomously at levels previously requiring much larger and more expensive models.
summary.zhHans: 2026年6月30日，Anthropic 发布 Claude Sonnet 5，并自7月1日起将其设为所有 Free 和 Pro 版 Claude 用户的默认模型。该模型以显著更低的成本提供接近 Opus 级别的智能体性能，2026年8月31日前入门价格为每百万输入 token 2美元、每百万输出 token 10美元。Anthropic 称 Sonnet 5 是'迄今为止最强大智能体能力的 Sonnet 模型'，能够制定计划、使用浏览器和终端等工具，并在此前需要更大更昂贵模型才能达到的水平上自主运行。

narrative.en: Anthropic launched Claude Sonnet 5 on June 30, 2026, the latest iteration of its mid-tier model line. The launch was notable for both its timing and positioning: Sonnet 5 arrived on the same day the US government lifted export controls on Anthropic's flagship Fable 5 model, creating a dual product story. Sonnet 5 was immediately set as the default model for Free and Pro users on Claude.ai and the Claude API. The model's key improvement was in agentic capabilities — Anthropic stated it could 'make plans, use tools like browsers and terminals, and run autonomously at a level that, just a few months ago, required larger and more expensive models.' Introductory pricing was set at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens through August 31, 2026, with post-promo pricing at $3 and $15 respectively. This pricing represented a significant reduction compared to Opus models, making frontier-adjacent agentic capabilities accessible to a broader developer audience. The launch confirmed months of speculation and positioned Sonnet 5 as Anthropic's volume driver while the flagship Opus and Fable lines remained premium offerings.
narrative.zhHans: Anthropic 于2026年6月30日发布了 Claude Sonnet 5，这是其中端模型系列的最新迭代。此次发布的时机和定位都值得关注：Sonnet 5 恰逢美国政府解除对 Anthropic 旗舰模型 Fable 5 出口管制的同一天，形成了双重产品叙事。Sonnet 5 立即被设为 Claude.ai 和 Claude API 上 Free 和 Pro 用户的默认模型。该模型的关键改进在于智能体能力——Anthropic 表示它可以'制定计划、使用浏览器和终端等工具，并在此前需要更大更昂贵模型才能达到的水平上自主运行。'入门价格定为每百万输入 token 2美元、每百万输出 token 10美元，有效期至2026年8月31日，促销后价格分别为3美元和15美元。这一价格相比 Opus 模型显著降低，使更多开发者能够获得接近前沿的智能体能力。此次发布证实了数月来的猜测，并将 Sonnet 5 定位为 Anthropic 的量产驱动力，而旗舰级的 Opus 和 Fable 系列则保持高端定位。

text.en: Claude Sonnet 5 was launched on June 30, 2026 and became the default model for all Free and Pro Claude users starting July 1.
text.zhHans: Claude Sonnet 5 于2026年6月30日发布，自7月1日起成为所有 Free 和 Pro 版 Claude 用户的默认模型。

text.en: Introductory pricing is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens through August 31, 2026, after which it will be $3/$15.
text.zhHans: 入门价格为每百万输入 token 2美元、每百万输出 token 10美元，有效期至2026年8月31日，之后为3/15美元。

text.en: Anthropic described it as its 'most agentic Sonnet model' capable of autonomous tool use and planning.
text.zhHans: Anthropic 称其为'最具智能体能力的 Sonnet 模型'，能够自主使用工具和制定计划。

description.en: Reduced pricing for near-flagship agentic capabilities makes advanced AI agents accessible to more developers and smaller businesses.
description.zhHans: 降低准旗舰级智能体能力的价格，使更多开发者和中小企业能够使用先进 AI 智能体。

description.en: Sonnet 5 brings near-Opus agentic capabilities to the mid-tier, narrowing the gap between flagship and volume models.
description.zhHans: Sonnet 5 将接近 Opus 的智能体能力带到中端产品，缩小了旗舰模型与量产模型之间的差距。
